neighbours.label: the distinguishing name word inside a grand cultural venue's name, above all British 'Royal ...' institutions (Royal Albert Hall, Royal Botanic Gardens, Victoria and Albert Museum, Royal Opera House); the same words outside a venue name stay quiet
fire: Her choir sang Handel at the Royal Albert Hall in front of five thousand people.
A rare orchid flowered this week at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Edinburgh.
The dress is on loan from the Victoria and Albert Museum until May.
He trained as a gardener at the Royal Botanic Garden in Sydney.
Tickets for the ballet at the Royal Opera House sold out in an hour.
The band will film its farewell concert at London's Royal Albert Hall.
Seeds from the expedition were sent to the Royal Botanic Gardens at Kew.
The curator moved from the Tate to the Victoria and Albert Museum last year.
quiet: Her choir sang Handel at the village church in front of fifty people.
A rare orchid flowered this week in my neighbour's greenhouse in Edinburgh.
The dress is on loan from my cousin Victoria until May.
He trained as a gardener at a plant nursery in Sydney.
Tickets for the ballet at the school gym sold out in an hour.
Queen Victoria married Prince Albert in the winter of 1840.
Seeds from the expedition were sent to the Royal Navy for storage.
The curator moved from the bank to the Federal Reserve last year.

notes: Card: 'anic' x7 (Royal Botanic Gardens), ' Albert' x3 (Royal Albert Hall, Victoria and Albert Museum), plus Cert'osa', Gran Te'atre', Palazzo Stroz'zi'. Probes: Royal Botanic Gardens 0.91, Royal Albert Hall 0.82, Victoria and Albert Museum 0.72, Royal Opera House 0.51, Palazzo Pitti 0.48, Uffizi Gallery 0.31; Prince Albert 0.21, Royal College of Art 0.18, Royal Navy 0.14, Sydney Opera House 0.14, Carnegie Hall 0.05, Globe Theatre 0.05, Federal Reserve Bank 0.06. So not every famous venue fires: the list (Royal/V&A names, some Italian palazzi) holds better than the general pattern. The - pole fires on the name word of official or regional bodies (German Federal Institute, Scottish Borders, Irish Independent).
